summary: BrainBoost learning district fully validated. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass against the live preview URL — hub (fact_of_day, categories with 'Religious Studies', course/quiz/video counts, featured, per-user lessons_completed), courses list + filter by 'Religious Studies' (returns bc8+bc9), course detail with lessons + persisted per-user completion (+/- toggle & GET round-trip), quiz list (no 'answer' leak), quiz detail (strips 'answer' key), quiz submit scoring (4/4, partial, empty), facts (deterministic per-date), videos-with-url, LLM lexicon (dictionary+thesaurus) and Repair Guy, and auth guard. Frontend: registered a fresh account, /brainboost renders Fact-of-the-Day, all 8 quick actions (Courses/Quizzes/Dictionary/Thesaurus/Fun Facts/Videos/Repair Guy/AI Tutor), and Featured courses; BrainBoost header title fits on one line (numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit); Courses screen filter chip 'Religious Studies' surfaces bc8/bc9; course detail expands lessons, mark-complete updates the progress bar 0/3->1/3 (33%); quiz flow (bq1) scores 4/4 with 'Try again' + correct highlighting; Facts page renders; Videos list renders (video-bv1); District /district/brainboost shows 'Enter BrainBoost' primary button and does NOT expose 'Religious Studies' as a top-level feature row. Bug found & fixed: districts collection was only seeded once (count==0) so previously-persisted 'Religious Studies' still appeared as a top-level BrainBoost feature from GET /api/districts/brainboost; added an idempotent $set update in seed() to sync features/name/icon/tagline/description/chatmonger from the DISTRICTS constant on every startup.
action_items: None blocking. Main agent may self-verify the two AI text screens (Dictionary/Thesaurus lookup and Repair Guy) in the mobile UI — backend LLM endpoints are covered by pytest but a UI screenshot smoke would round it out.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:928-935 — seed() was creating the districts collection only when empty, so post-launch feature-list edits (removing 'Religious Studies' from BrainBoost.features) never propagated to the DB. Fixed with an idempotent $set update per district in seed().
server.py:2472-2479 — brainboost_quiz_detail() correctly strips 'answer' before returning; confirmed by test.
server.py:2482-2490 — brainboost_quiz_submit() scores by index and returns full correct[] key; frontend uses that to render highlighting.
server.py:920-922 — _bb_fact_for() is a modulo over a fixed pool from an epoch, giving deterministic per-day facts as required.
frontend/app/brainboost/index.tsx:57-60 — header BrainBoost title uses numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit so it always fits one line.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (seed() now syncs district features/name/icon/tagline/description/chatmonger from DISTRICTS on every startup)
seed_data_creation: TEST_/bbfe_ prefixed users created via /api/auth/register; per-user course-progress rows for the fresh test user only. No mutation of seeded courses/quizzes/videos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow toggles: root '/' alternates login <-> register. Use testIDs 'login-*' or 'register-*' to disambiguate placeholders (both forms have 'Email' and 'Password'). Registration form: register-name / register-email / register-password + click 'Forge my ID'. BrainBoost courses IDs: bc1..bc10 (bc8 & bc9 are Religious Studies). Quizzes: bq1..bq5. bq1 answer key is [1,2,1,2]. All /brainboost* endpoints require Bearer auth. Category filter uses exact string 'Religious Studies'.
